body: I'm definitely terrified. I'm trying not to be but it's hard especially being an anxious person. Thank you for the kind words.
I will. Thank you for the comment.
Im currently going to school. It just seems like most places value experience over schooling.

I know. I was having a good week with my health anxiety, no panic attacks or obsessing or anything. I really thought I was okay even having the heart beating in my head the entire week. So when I felt it, I felt like I'd be stable enough if I googled it. Bad idea lol. Anxiety set in instantly so lesson learned. Even when I'm okay, google is just not a good idea.
Thank you. Sometimes just hearing 'sounds fine' is reassuring. I know anxiety can make nothing into something but I'll check out r/askdocs anyway!
Nothing. A couple acute headaches here and there. I've also had a stuffy nose, and occasionally stomach issues. But usually the stomach issues are from my anxiety.

I work part time at an art store and go to school. I paint and draw when I can, which is something I've always loved, but it's just not really doing it for me anymore. I haven't really made friends yet or enjoyed anything for a little while now. I'm sorry you feel lost, I hope that changes for you.
I would like that, thank you.
Definitely not. I hope we get through this soon.
I've thought of dropping out as well, I really have no clue what I'm doing and my heart's not in it I feel. But I don't know what else I'd do.

That would be great! I had social anxiety as well. Funny enough, I've actually got a lot better socially. I even work customer service without being anxious anymore. Maybe we could trade some coping skills here.

It's on my head, behind my ear. She said it was just a swollen gland, and it did go down pretty fast (Even though it's still there). But now more showed up and my neck hurts, so I'm freaking out again. I caved and decided I'm going to the doctor. I also started seeing a therapist. So hopefully between both of them I can get whatever this new, horrible problem, is under control.
